none: PAS CAM-141B44: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, AD347-348, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN. Reverse shows two Victories with wreaths. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.15g, diameter is 14.28mm
